issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

appIds.description: Apps that will be invalidated for operations that support multi-app invalidation (e.g. stored calc).

defaultMergeProbability.description:
The probability used to determine how often to attempt to merge existing queue entries with existing ones (for
mergeable queues only.

upsertAsyncProcessingDisabled.description: If true, upserts will not trigger async invalidation/processing (except for the async callbacks).
